decisions.decision: Funds collected at Lunenburg Relief Day will be disclosed in a letter to the donors, once the final decision on their use is made.
decisions.quote: it was decided that whatever the final decision was of how the money is going to be used, it should disclosed in a letter to the donors.

decisions.decision: Money not spent on the Eagle House parking lot project will be returned to the Friends of the Eagle House Inc.
decisions.quote: ms. noble explained the particulars to the town manager and the money will be returned to the friends group.

decisions.decision: Ms. Noble will research another phone system with the help of the town IT Director.
decisions.quote: ms. noble will be researching another phone system with the assistance of the it director for the town.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Noble reported that $10K had been approved through Capital Planning to replace the main kitchen oven, refrigerator and steam table.
budget_items.quote: ms. noble reported that $10k was approved through capitol planning to replace the oven, refrigerator and steam table in the main kitchen at the center.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Donations collected for the COA at Relief Day totaled about $5K, short of the $12K budget cut; the funds go to the COA Revolving Gift Fund.
budget_items.quote: donations collected totaled approximately $5k which is short of the $12k budget cut.

budget_items.topic: Relief Day funds available for Friday opening
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Seeley said the $5K collected would amount to only about $125 available to reopen on Fridays with 10 months left in FY13.
budget_items.quote: ms. seeley mentioned that with the $5k collected it would only amount to approximately $125. available to be spent on opening on fridays

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Formula Grant increased, amounting to $7 per elder in the town; grant money covers MOW mileage, Outreach salary, MCOA conference fees and dues, and travel for the MCOA Executive Board.
budget_items.quote: there was an increase in the formula grant which will amount to $7 per elder in the town.

budget_items.topic: Eagle House parking lot funds returned
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unexpended funds from the Eagle House parking lot project are to be returned to the Friends of the Eagle House Inc.; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: she had been working with the town account to have funds returned to the friends of the eagle house inc. which were not expended for the parking lot project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Noble said the FY14 operating budget must be based on hard planning, not on possible Relief Fund donations; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: ms. noble said that she must follow a hard planning perspective for fy14 and that she cannot base an operating budget on what may or may not come in via donations from the relief fund.

budget_items.topic: COA and Library budget cuts and override
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Raboin said the COA and Library budget cuts were a scare tactic tied to the override that failed at Town Meeting in May; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the cuts to the coa and library budgets were used as a "scare tactic" in order to pass the proposed override, which failed at town meeting in may.
